selected_script.angle: Decluttering kitchen countertops by utilizing vertical magnetic surfaces
selected_script.hook: Stop letting messy spice jars take over your limited countertop space.

video_001_part_01.visual: 0-3s: Handheld shot of a cluttered, messy kitchen countertop with spice jars rolling around, showing someone accidentally knocking a bottle over. 3-6s: Quick cut to a matte black rectangular metal spice rack snapping magnetically onto the side of a clean refrigerator. 6-10s: A close-up of hands neatly placing glass spice jars and oil bottles onto the rack, showing it holds them securely.
video_001_part_01.audio: Tired of crowded kitchen counters? Just snap these heavy-duty magnetic racks onto your fridge to instantly clear up space.

video_001_part_02.visual: 0-4s: Cut to the side of a washing machine, where another identical matte black magnetic rack holds laundry detergent and dryer sheets. 4-8s: Close-up of a kitchen towel being hung onto the detachable metal hooks hanging from the bottom edge of the rack on the fridge. 8-10s: Wide shot of the organized kitchen area with a light text overlay: 'Organize your space in seconds.'
video_001_part_02.audio: They work on washing machines, microwaves, or any iron surface. Hang tools and towels on the hooks to keep everything in reach. Organize your space in seconds.
